moods.mood_description: The prince sits beneath the Bodhi tree to find the truth
Awakening or defeat — the end of suffering or its continuation
The assault of Mara — desire, fear, doubt, and delusion
The forces of delusion against the still, unmoving mind
The long night of struggle before the dawn
Mara tempts the prince to rise; the prince does not move
The morning star rises, and the prince becomes the Buddha
The awakening — the end of suffering, found within
The first sermon and the wheel of dharma
The greatest victory is won by sitting still
